_comment: Store screenshot headlines, in the order the stores show them. Each names a raw screenshot (wallet/maestro, takeScreenshot) and the short phrase framed above it. Apple: a short phrase that enhances the visual rather than describes it; no prices, URLs or claims that cannot be verified.
